title: Crispy Fried Rice
description: A simple and delicious fried rice dish with a crispy twist.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced syrian olives and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the vibrant olives and cook for an additional minute.
Push the olives to one side of the skillet.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the other side of the skillet.
Add 2 cups of cooked rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Mix the rice with the olives and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving platter.
Garnish with fried olives and serve immediately.
